caption: The drawing depicts a single wooden chair with a square seat and a straight backrest. The chair frame is painted black and is decorated with yellow floral or wheat designs along the vertical and horizontal edges. The top and bottom edges of the backrest, as well as the front apron below the seat, feature oval panels with green palm fronds or leafy designs. The backrest consists of five vertical slats, each painted a light tan color with diagonal red and cream bands. The seat appears to be a woven cane or rush pattern depicted in a light brown color. The chair legs are slender and straight, each front leg decorated with a yellow floral motif and yellow outlines. The background is plain and off-white, with a few brownish spots scattered across the top of the drawing.
title: Side Chair
